items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: You know I got to talk with a couple of the guys who had come up here, Kidd Jordan.

ctx.x: A gig is a gig. You know sometimes I wish — well I don’t necessarily wish that I’d been there during that time, but I wonder what it would have been like to be there at a time when all those clubs on Bourbon Street were jazz clubs. And when a lot of the older musicians that have since passed on, when they were still alive, living, and what their experiences were like, you know what I mean? I hear stories, but it would have been interesting to see what that would have been like to be around those cats.
Yeah. You know I got to talk with a couple of the guys who had come up here, Kidd Jordan.
